Description:
[list]
[*][size=6]Installing Guide[/size]
[/list]
[list=1]
[*]download and install [nodejs] (https://nodejs.org/en/) (LTS version)
[*]unzip the folder anywhere you want.

[/list][list]
[*][size=6]to add new animals[/size]
[/list][list=1]
[*]Paste your config.json from BFAV folder file in the same folder.
[*]put the animals.js file (overwrite) in this folder
[*]after that open a terminal command of your operating system in this folder. (tip: with you write cmd in the path of urls will open cmd in this folder)
[*]digit npm run animals
[*]press enter
[*]Check if receive this message (config.json was updated, Copy the config.json file in your BFAV file)
[*]now copy the new config.json file and paste in BFAV folder.
[*]Done!

[/list][list]
[*]To add new type of animals
[/list][list=1]
[*]Paste your config.json from BFAV folder file in the same folder.
[*]put the type.js file(overwrite) in this folder.
[*]after that open a terminal command of your operating system in this folder (tip:with you write cmd in the path of url will open cmd in this folder)
[*]digit npm run type
[*]press enter
[*]check if receive this message(config.json was update,Copy the config.json file in you bfav file) without any error message.
[*]now copy the new config.json file and pastee in BFAV folder
[*]Done!
[/list]
